snippet.title: FNAF: Wii U Edition v1.3 Update - Petit Macchiato
snippet.description:
The final major update of FnaF: Wii U Edition is here ! This update brings a ton of exciting new features to the game. You won’t be disappointed! 

This video introduces a new character concept we’re working with: Petit Macchiato ! (Source Macchiato lore confirmed ?!)

============== 🎮Let’s play !🎮 ==============

🔵Join us on Discord for EXCLUSIVE Updates : https://discord.com/invite/Cpm5nAEEzY

🕹Wanna play ? Download page : https://source-macchiato.itch.io/fnaf-wiiu-edition
GitHub : https://github.com/Source-Macchiato
BlueSky : https://bsky.app/profile/sourcemacchiato.com
Tiktok : https://www.tiktok.com/@sourcemacchiato

Achievement on WiiU : https://github.com/The-Latte-Team/Collection-Room

Special thanks to Pxie_Pixel for voicing our little mascot!
Her Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/candys_cosplay

And remember : *do NOT do the Konami Code on the main menu…*
